sources.entry: Suno - A cutting-edge AI tool focused on transforming music creation with advanced deep learning models for audio generation and enhancement.

summary.name: Suno
summary.one_liner: Suno is an AI music generator that creates complete original songs with vocals, lyrics, and production from a text prompt.
use_cases: Creating complete original songs from a text prompt
Making royalty free music for YouTube, podcasts, or ads
Writing and turning lyrics into a sung track
summary.what_it_does: Suno generates full songs including vocals, instrumentation, and production from a single text prompt describing genre, mood, theme, or lyrics, typically in under a minute. Users can regenerate, extend, or refine tracks after creation. The free tier allows up to 10 songs a day without a credit card. Paid Pro and Premier plans add higher monthly song limits, commercial use rights, stem separation into vocal and instrument stems, and audio uploads up to 8 minutes. Premier adds Suno Studio, a multitrack generative audio workstation with MIDI export and Persona Voices.
notable: Generates complete songs with vocals and full production, not just short instrumental loops
Suno Studio generative audio workstation with multitrack editing and MIDI export (Premier plan)
Stem separation into vocal and instrument stems (Pro plan and above)
Pro plan includes commercial use rights and royalty free music
caveats: Free tier limited to 10 songs a day
Pro and Premier plans are paid; Pro includes 500 songs a month and Premier 2,000 songs a month
Annual billing gives a 20% discount on paid plans
